name: t3_environment_links
title: List linked environments
description: List linked environments (the user's other machines) and whether each answers now. Pass one's `environmentId` to a tool to act there; `delegate_task` takes `target.environmentId`. Expired: link it again with `t3_environment_link`.

name: t3_environment_link
title: Link another environment
description: Ask the user to link another machine, in a card. For a machine the user names that is not linked. Pass `hint` from their words, `environmentId` when one names it (already linked: returns `linked`), `url` only when the user gave an address. Returns `pending`; the outcome arrives as a message in this thread. Do not wait, poll, or call it again to check. Never ask for a pairing code in chat.

environmentId.description: The machine, when known, e.g. from a mentioned machine. Otherwise the user picks it in the card.

url.description: Only an address the user gave: https, Tailscale, LAN or loopback. Never guess one.

hint.description: The user's words for the machine, e.g. "vps". Preselects it in the card.

requestedAccess.description: Suggested access. The user picks; default approval-required.

name: t3_environment_unlink
title: Forget a linked environment
description: Forget a linked environment. That machine's Connections list its session until revoked there.
